question.text: A USDINR put with strike 84.00 when spot is 84.50. What is its moneyness and intrinsic value?

answer.text: Out of the money (OTM), intrinsic value = Rs. 0
In the money (ITM), intrinsic value = Rs. 0.50
At the money (ATM), intrinsic value = Rs. 0

explanation.text: The Logic: A put is OTM when the underlying price is higher than the strike price. Here strike 84.00 is lower than spot 84.50, so the put is OTM. Its intrinsic value is max(strike - spot, 0) = max(84.00 - 84.50, 0) = 0. The Trap: Rs. 0.50 would be the intrinsic value for a call (spot above strike). Put moneyness is the mirror of a call, so spot above strike makes the put OTM with zero intrinsic value, not ITM. Note: Workbook reference — pp.69-70 (put OTM when spot is above strike, OTM options have zero intrinsic value).
